origin: Native cached decode panel and fixed normalization
output_budget: Predicted native tokens including EOS if emitted; stop early on native EOS only
exact_literal: Decoded reply excluding special EOS, otherwise unmodified, equals canonical gold
prefix_agreement: Nonempty literal reply is a character prefix of canonical gold, including exact
semantic_value: Whole reply equals a presealed complete authored value after casefold and one optional leading a/an/the
synonym_scope: Only action values with explicitly declared corpus aliases
timing_scope: CUDA synchronized forward plus argmax/ID transfer; input tensor setup and text/scoring separate
license: Repo-authored Apache-2.0 panel and cached Apache-2.0 checkpoint; no weights vendored
scope: Native vocabulary projection and cached decoding only; no attention-based measurement
publication_note: Public portability manifest, not a new preregistration. Original fixed scoring and measured replies/timings are unchanged.
